episodes.title: The Station Strangler Part 1
episodes.summary: An enthralling premiere of this South African crime thriller. Set in Mitchell's Plain, 1994, a young man goes missing, and the police approach psychologist Dr Micki Pistorius to help with the case.

episodes.title: The Station Strangler Part 2
episodes.summary: Chris and AJ arrest the man who has been writing the letters to the press. Micki attends the post-mortem of Joey Adamse - her first, and the case is taking its toll on AJ.

episodes.title: Cleveland
episodes.summary: In Pretoria, Micki meets Brigadier Brink, who puts her onto a new case: another body has just been found in the Cleveland mine dumps.

episodes.title: The ABC Killer
episodes.summary: Micki and Erika are off to work on a new case: fifteen dead women are found in Atteridgeville. But almost immediately, the team are called, as a new body is discovered at a horrifying scene.

episodes.title: Donnybrook
episodes.summary: Micki is summoned to the small town of Donnybrook to assist Detectives Nick and Solomon in trying to get a confession out of a suspect in the next forty-eight hours before he appears in court.

episodes.title: The Cape Town Prostitute Killer
episodes.summary: Micki returns to Cape Town to work on a new case. A serial killer targets prostitutes. A potential suspect emerges, but extracting a confession becomes a race against time.

episodes.title: Stewart Wilken
episodes.summary: In Port Elizabeth, a missing boy sparks a frantic search. Micki arrives to testify in the trial of the 'cannibal killer,' Stewart Wilken. However, the sensationalized press complicates her efforts.

episodes.title: The Phoenix Strangler Part 1
episodes.summary: The discovery of a series of bodies in sugar cane fields sends Micki to Durban. With her caseload increasing, her exhaustion and panic attacks increase too. This raises concerns amongst the team for both Micki and her methods.

episodes.title: The Phoenix Strangler Part 2
episodes.summary: The case of the Phoenix Strangler continues with more bodies being discovered. Micki makes a breakthrough, and her team faces a perilous situation as they chase down a suspect.

episodes.title: The Saloon Killer Part 1
episodes.summary: Micki faces her toughest case yet - she is brought on board to find a shooter responsible for randomly murdering tens of villagers in KZN.

episodes.title: The Saloon Killer Part 2
episodes.summary: Micki presents her course in Cape Town, where she also reunites with AJ; the Saloon Shooter guns down two people in Phoswa Village.
